verdict.rationale: Circle documents support for its own stablecoins: USDC, EURC, cirBTC via Gateway, and USDC-backed tokens via xReserve. Some networks are named (EVM, Solana, Arc), and a CPN endpoint returns the supported blockchains. There is no evidence of USDT or other third-party stablecoins, and no explicit per-chain support matrix appears in the pack. missing for 10: USDT/third-party stablecoin support, a documented list of named supported networks per asset, independent corroboration.
